title: Conditional κ = 0.000751056919813402: donor-weighted matching on gen5b kernels
body:
The new `research/gen5b-weighted-matching/` package rebuilds compensated reuse **after producer endpoint descent**, choosing donors by their actual final-frame rank, and composes the resulting word with every PR299 kernel, restoration and terminal sink.

**Conditional κ = 375528459906701 / 500000000000000000 = 0.000751056919813402.**

This is **0.154381% above independently reproduced PR299** (`0.000749899215319498`) and **0.776099% above this PR's previous published checkpoint**. It also exceeds the newer PR300 advertised value (`0.000749917931696438`); that package was read for comparison, not independently replayed here. The current frontier was checked before publication; no global-optimality claim is made.

The exact post-descent graph has 65,920 eligible donor edges. Rebuilding matching admits **1,728 reuse pairs instead of 1,726**, and donor-rank weighting chooses **878 rank-21 donors instead of 706**. For each fixed exponent between zero and one, higher donor rank increases the donor-only splice benefit. A transversal-matroid argument supports the weighted rule on this fixed graph; Hopcroft-Karp independently checks maximum cardinality. This does not assert optimality over producer frames, module designs, later transforms or the full finite construction.

| Quantity | PR299 | This package |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Reuse pairs | 1726 | 1728 |
| Final independent dirty registers | 15427 | 15425 |
| Literal stock, 60 replicas | 1229750 | 1229735 |
| Kernel entries | 1720 | 1720 |
| Early restorations | 440 | 440 |
| Terminal sinks | 7 | 7 |

All 904 scalar retimings and 220 target groups are rebound to the new word. All 1,720 kernel entries are mapped through logical roles and rechecked. All 440 restorations and seven sinks are freshly screened. The original kernel/restore/sink checker cores, bank checker, prime checker, rational moment engines, outer assembly, mathematical and finite checks remain unchanged; exact counts, namespace, residual census and expected derived pins are specialized with assertions retained. Full original-to-candidate source hashes are in `SOURCE.json`.

The complete invoice includes 913 endpoint charts, the conservative normalizer 815, 905,876,840,400 selector calls, primitive coefficient `90287809388474101` and a 98-bit signed payload bound. Cleanup and arbitrary dirty old-value return remain paid. The final physical word SHA-256 is `20bb646a143f8bf9096c1a792e4ef6b087a925a9211832e88db9da65a08106d2`; package manifest is `54a8a9c1f1241ed2555232476e5af8e7dc64c8fef5f13e84331981fb93f52ee6`.

Reproduction requires Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0 and new output directories:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/gen5b-weighted-matching/requirements.txt
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/verify.py \
  --output /tmp/gen5b-weighted-verification
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py \
  --work /tmp/gen5b-weighted-regeneration
```

The verifier freshly executes all twelve stages, rejects pin-recording mode, runs the retained mutation and omitted-stage controls, and rechecks every source hash at completion. The producer command regenerates the original word from module data, applies endpoint descent and the new weighted matching, checks every local F2 and defining-integer-decoder column, and reproduces all five pinned bit files exactly (gzip content compared after decompression). Neither command consumes cached PASS receipts. The dedicated workflow runs full verification on Python 3.11 and 3.13 and regeneration on Python 3.13.

Two separate full immutable replays passed on the candidate and its final public package; the latter completed in 254.44 seconds with all 152 source inputs unchanged. End-to-end regeneration reproduced every pinned bit file. Independent source, mathematical-change, producer, workflow, staged-blob and privacy reviews passed. Published signed head: `03acc26f9624ce15c4149f927b7b9aeb0de301b8`. Exact-head CI results will be added when all workflows finish.

The inherited all-size compiler, common chart, restored-row, selector, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-correctness and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. This is a conditional finite construction, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a new Lean proof or a practical runtime benchmark.

Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including Ody's matching research and coordinated independent integration/review. Compensated reuse itself and the other mechanisms are inherited. Credits include Chafik Boukhalfa (PR299/296 and the supplier chain), DreamingOfClouds' modules and producers, Rohan Arun's retiming, Eumemic's source527 lineage, Dugongue's kernels/banking/sinks, utcorvusvolat-dotcom's restorations, and the full retained contributor chain. Original PR299 notices, licenses and README are preserved. Earlier PR275 packages remain reproducible historical checkpoints; this package supplies the PR's current strongest result.
